summary: Author and creator Sahil Bloom navigates the chaotic whirlwind of launching his debut book, ***The Five Types of Wealth***, while reflecting on the profound personal transformation that led to his career pivot from finance to writing. Throughout the hectic media tours and unexpected travel delays, he emphasizes that society often relies on **money as a default life scoreboard**, which ultimately creates an unfulfilling pursuit of endless wealth rather than true contentment. Instead of chasing external validation or climbing the wrong mountains quickly, he urges individuals to **focus on direction over speed** by defining what genuinely matters to them. By redefining success around essential pillars like time, relationships, health, and vitality, Bloom encourages people to **invest in meaningful relationships** just as they would financially, recognizing that **choosing the right game to win** is the ultimate key to a balanced and fulfilling life.
